questions.text: Moseley arranged the elements in the periodic table in ascending order according to their ______.
The modern periodic table consists of ______ vertical groups.
Elements located in the d-block are called ______ metals.
The elements of group 1A are called:
The elements of group 2A are called:
The halogens are located in group:
The noble gases are located in group:
All elements of the d-block are transition metals.
The p-block is located on the left side of the modern periodic table.
The d-block consists of 10 vertical groups.
Give a reason: Scientists rearranged the elements periodically in the modern periodic table.
questions.answer: To facilitate the study of elements and reveal periodic relationships between their properties.

questions.text: Compare elements in the same group and elements in the same period in terms of electron configuration.
questions.answer: Same group: same number of electrons in the outermost energy level. Same period: same number of occupied energy levels.

questions.text: An element whose atoms have 7 electrons in the outermost energy level belongs to:
Which group contains elements whose outermost energy level is completely filled?
The Lewis dot structure represents the ______ electrons of an atom.
The valency of chlorine is:
Which element is the most chemically active among the halogens?
Which property generally increases down a group?
Give a reason: Elements of the same group have similar chemical properties.
questions.answer: Because they have the same number of electrons in their outermost energy level.

questions.text: Compare alkali metals and halogens in the trend of chemical activity down their groups.
questions.answer: Alkali metals: chemical activity increases down the group. Halogens: chemical activity decreases down the group.

questions.text: The modern periodic table contains ______ periods and ______ groups.
The f-block contains the ______ and ______ series.
Give a reason: Potassium is a solid element at room temperature.
questions.answer: It is an alkali metal, and the alkali metals studied are solid metals except for the separately noted liquid metals outside this group.

questions.text: An element has electron configuration 2,8,1. Determine its period and group.
An element has electron configuration 2,8,7. Determine its period and group.
Compare s-block and p-block in location and number of groups.
questions.answer: s-block occupies the left side and contains 2 groups; p-block occupies the right side and contains 6 groups.

questions.text: Metalloids are located in the p-block and cannot be identified only by electron configuration.
Consultant-generated application: Two elements have the same number of valence electrons but different numbers of occupied energy levels. What is the likely relationship between them?
questions.answer: They are likely in the same group but in different periods.
